notes.title: Minor Patch 1.5 & Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope the start of summer has been treating you guys well so far :D

We're here with a new minor patch. Version 1.5 includes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the achievement Death Master didn't get unlocked.
[*] Minor bugs with stats checks display.
[*] Multiple typo fixes (Thank you, everyone, for the reports! You guys got hawk eyes :D )
[/list]

[b]Important for Mac users![/b]
After this minor patch, you might not be able to skip old / already read text anymore. [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lhxFLAH6zc97MhpUEJ4_QVfWfto4x5WBRSFwYlWkVcc/edit]There may also be minor problems with loading saves from the middle of the scene as mentioned here.[/url]

We really, really apologize to you guys for the inconvenience. However, this time, we've made sure this doesn't happen again in the future! >_< We hope for your understanding.

At last, we're holding a small summer sale for both the game and the artbook/guide! :D
Thank you for the support. Take care everyone!

Cheers,
Nifty Visuals

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! :D
We're just dropping by to tell you that we've uploaded a new build with minor bugs / typo fixes! Version 1.4 includes:
[list]
[*] Improvements on the Grimoire's "Routes" screen.
[*] Fixed a major bug that made you skip Week 59 sometimes.
[*] Many minor typo fixes.
[/list]

However, it has been reported to us that old text can't be skipped anymore and some old saves may not work.
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lhxFLAH6zc97MhpUEJ4_QVfWfto4x5WBRSFwYlWkVcc/edit]Here is a guide to which saves are still alright![/url] We sincerely apologize for any inconveniences >_<


[url=https://bit.ly/RA-Raffle]Furthermore, for those who didn't know, we're holding an art raffle that's still running for 2-3 days! :D[/url]
